=WITH return_data AS (
    SELECT return_id, return_status
    FROM (
        SELECT
            return_id,
            status AS return_status,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY return_id
                ORDER BY return_id ASC
            ) AS rn
        FROM workspace.agentic_support.returns
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),

exchange_data AS (
    SELECT return_id, exchange_status
    FROM (
        SELECT
            return_id,
            status AS exchange_status,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY return_id
                ORDER BY return_id ASC
            ) AS rn
        FROM workspace.agentic_support.exchanges
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),

inspection_data AS (
    SELECT
        return_id,
        inspection_status,
        inspection_note
    FROM (
        SELECT
            return_id,
            status AS inspection_status,
            note AS inspection_note,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY return_id
                ORDER BY inspection_id DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM workspace.agentic_support.inspections
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),

refund_data AS (
    SELECT
        return_id,
        refund_count
    FROM (
        SELECT
            return_id,
            COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY return_id) AS refund_count,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY return_id
                ORDER BY return_id ASC
            ) AS rn
        FROM workspace.agentic_support.refunds
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),

order_data AS (
    SELECT order_id, item
    FROM (
        SELECT
            order_id,
            item,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY order_id
                ORDER BY order_id ASC
            ) AS rn
        FROM workspace.agentic_support.orders
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)

SELECT
    t.kind,
    t.external_system,
    t.order_id,
    t.return_id,
    t.last_status,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.updated_at, 'dd MMM') AS updated,
    r.return_status,
    e.exchange_status,
    i.inspection_status,
    i.inspection_note,
    COALESCE(f.refund_count, 0) AS refund_count,
    o.item

FROM workspace.agentic_support.request_tracker t

LEFT JOIN return_data r
    ON r.return_id = t.return_id

LEFT JOIN exchange_data e
    ON e.return_id = t.return_id

LEFT JOIN inspection_data i
    ON i.return_id = t.return_id

LEFT JOIN refund_data f
    ON f.return_id = t.return_id

LEFT JOIN order_data o
    ON o.order_id = t.order_id

WHERE t.customer_id = '{{ $json.customer_id }}'
  AND (
      t.order_id = '{{ $json.reference }}'
      OR t.return_id = '{{ $json.reference }}'
      OR t.external_id = '{{ $json.reference }}'
  )

ORDER BY t.created_at DESC
LIMIT 6;
